title: Sky3N's Craftable Light
description: Now you can get light in the darkest cave.
body:
# Description
This datapack is mostly explained by it's name. It adds 3 new crafting recepies for the vanilla light block.
# Recepies
Most of you are probably only reading this because you want to see the recepies, so here they are:

![Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1cb96595ed060a1bb6786658940382f147027ee5.png)

![Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/de263f68bb41b9f9a52a655495f7c6b1ff36ed6f.png)

![Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a1f2a718782681327826f51a2d211f310fbf775a_0.webp)

The empty bottles symbolise a empty light bulb.
